title_sq: Shitet 2+1 ne Allias, vet Pronari, jo Agjensi ❌
description_sq:
Shitet apartament 2+1 ne Allias, ne rrugen Njazi Meka, prane Big Market dhe Bar Piceri Gashit.
Apartamenti disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekore dhe eshte ne pallat ekzistues ne katin e peste dhe te fundit pa ashensor. 
Shtepia eshte e mobiluar ne kushte bashkekohore dhe organizohet ne dhome ndenje, dy dhoma gjumi, kuzhine gatimi me vete dhe tualeti me dritare.
Tarraca eshte e izoluar, nuk ka lageshti dhe ka vetem nje depozite uji personale.
Lagja eshte e qete dhe ka prane saj çerdhe, kopshte, shkolla dhe gjimnaz. Gjithashtu eshte prane stavioni i autobuzit ku kalojne 2 linja dhe spitali "Nene Tereza" eshte shume afer.
Cmimi eshte 96,000,000 leke te vjetra i diskutueshem vetem nga afer, nuk pranoj bashkepunime me agjensi imobiliare ❌
title_en: 2+1 for sale in Allias, the Owner himself, not the Agency ❌
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in Allias, on Njazi Meka street, near Big Market and Bar Pizzari Gashi. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation and is in the existing building on the fifth and last floor without an elevator. The house is furnished in contemporary conditions and is organized in a living room, two bedrooms, a self-catering kitchen and a bathroom with a window. The terrace is isolated, there is no humidity and there is only one personal water deposit. The neighborhood is quiet and there are nurseries, kindergartens, schools and high schools nearby. It is also near the bus station where 2 lines pass and the "Mother Teresa" hospital is very close. The price is 96,000,000 old lek, negotiable only from close, I do not accept cooperation with real estate agencies ❌
